name: Fal.ai
tagline: Serverless generative media API for image, video, and audio models.
description: Fal.ai provides a serverless API platform for running generative AI models (image, video, audio) with queue-based and real-time endpoints, model gallery, and client SDKs.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Key YOUR_API_KEY header (or fal-key).

example.request: curl -X POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/dev -H "Authorization: Key YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"a cat"}'
